items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Johnny Otis; the interviewer mentions Johnny Otis in the context of the interviewee's acquaintance Rene.

ctx.x: I knew Rene. -- because he was playing.
Like Johnny Otis at the time, I remember Johnny had just about all black band except maybe Rene (inaudible). But at that period there were very few bands that were mixed.
